anysat_torch_hub.recovery_note: torch.hub strips git metadata when it unzips a GitHub archive. If branch_or_sha is 'main', the exact commit at fetch time is not recoverable from the cache. cache_mtime_utc_approx is the cache directory's mtime, an approximate proxy for when AnySat was fetched; a reviewer can look up gastruc/anysat HEAD on GitHub at roughly that timestamp to bound the commit.
